s: The Perfection score measures how much of the game content a player has completed. Achieving a score of 100% unlocks extra endgame content.

s are shared among all players) will show the highest score any of the players in the game have completed. For example, this means that only one person needs to catch every fish for the score to show 100% for that category. Similarly, only one Gold Clock needs to be built to get a value of "Yes" for "Golden Clock on Farm." However, the scores cannot be split amongst players. The "watery cave" is the mushroom cave on Ginger Island where
Fizz will offer to sell the player perfection waivers in order to bypass perfection challenges. For 500,000g players can increase their perfection score by 1%.
Players can receive this letter even if they have already achieved perfection.
If a player reached perfection in a previous version of the game, the "Perfection Tracker" statue in
will show that the player has not reached perfection if they haven't cooked all the new foods, caught the new fish, crafted all the new recipes, and shipped all of the new items. However,
remains accessible if it was unlocked before.

It is cheaper to buy perfection waivers than to build the obelisks and golden clock. Those buildings cost a total of 13,000,000g to build and provide 14% of perfection. 14 perfection waivers only cost 7,000,000g, saving a total of 6,000,000g.
